summary: It's not possible to replace armor by right clicking while holding the armor item
description:
## The bug

What I expected to happen was for me to able to replace the armor with another piece of armor, like on the Bedrock edition of Minecraft.

What actually happened was that did not happen and it did not do anything when I right click to try and replace the armor.

## How to reproduce

 - Grab 2 different pieces of the same type of armor, eg. 1 netherite chestplate and 1 diamond chestplate

 - Put one of the pieces off armor on the armor slot in the inventory

 - Put the other piece of armor in the hotbar

 - Select that piece of armor and right click
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. From the main menu, select Singleplayer and create a Creative world with default settings.
3. Open the inventory and obtain two different pieces of the same armor type, such as a netherite chestplate and a diamond chestplate.
4. Place one armor piece in its corresponding armor slot.
5. Place the other armor piece in the hotbar.
6. Select the armor piece in the hotbar.
7. Right-click while holding the selected armor piece.
8. Observe that the equipped armor is not replaced and nothing happens.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.16.5, 21w07a, 21w08a, 21w08b, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w17a, 1.17, 1.17.1, 21w39a, 1.18, 1.18.1, 22w15a, 1.19 Pre-release 1, 1.19 Pre-release 2, 1.19 Pre-release 3, 1.19 Pre-release 5, 1.19, 22w45a, 23w04a (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
### Actual behavior

Right-clicking while holding a different piece of armor for an already occupied armor slot does not equip or replace the currently worn armor. The armor already equipped remains in its slot, and the held armor remains in the hotbar (or the player’s hand). No swap occurs and no other visible action takes place.
Expected Behavior: Right-clicking while holding a piece of armor should equip it in the corresponding armor slot when that slot already contains another piece of the same armor type. The newly held armor should replace the equipped piece, while the previously equipped armor should be swapped into the player’s hand, allowing armor to be changed directly without opening the inventory.
